title: Clara Chae
text: Hi! My name is Clara, and I’m a senior at Pomona College studying Environmental Analysis and Economics. I am from Boston, MA, play for the Pomona-Pitzer Women’s Golf Team, and love spending time outside (the photo above is me on the Beehive Trail in Acadia National Park this past summer!).
